name: Flutter app deploy requires simulation and explicit confirmation
trigger: Replay a spoken Flutter app request through create, Android APK build, simulated deploy, ACP confirmation, and publish.
observe: simulation must return a passing receipt before confirmation is requested
declined, malformed, or cancelled confirmation never publishes
published URL must match the trusted origin assigned at app creation
expected: The app publishes only after a passing simulation and explicit yes, and only at its assigned public origin.
